title: rDPS Meter
changeNote: 0.1.25 - a co-op fix for summoned pets. A pet that dies and is summoned back is built entirely out of the summon that revived it, but the meter went on crediting whoever paid for the hit points it died with. So a teammate who spent one Legion of Bone early in a fight kept taking a share of everything the replacement soaked, and the player who actually bought it back was credited for only part of their own pet. Topping up a living pet is unchanged and still splits the credit between everyone who chipped in. Verified against game v0.111.0; still works on v0.107.1 and later.
